## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The release gate change needs fixing before merge: `approved` now rejects a release with exactly the minimum number of approvals, and the existing tests use only 3 and 1 approvals, so they pass with either operator.

## Changes
The pull request regenerates `aaa-generated/catalog.json` with `production-service-NNNN` entries on ports 20000–21499 and adds a top-level `review_note` key. It also rewrites `healthy` as `not failures` and changes the release approval comparison from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` in the approval comparison — `approved(2, minimum=2)` now returns `False` because `approvals > minimum` requires one more approval than configured. The module docstring at `zzz-release/gate.py:1` states "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." — Releases that have exactly the required number of approvals are blocked from shipping. — Fix: Return `approvals >= minimum` and add an `approved(2, minimum=2)` case to `tests/test_release.py`, because `test_approved_release` (3) and `test_blocked_release` (1) pass under both operators.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- aaa-generated/catalog.json:6002 — correctness — Remove the hand-added `review_note` key from the catalog — A consumer that reads `catalog[name]["port"]` for every top-level key fails on `review_note` because its value is a string, not a service object. Every other top-level value in the file is a `{port, enabled}` object, and the key does not follow the generated `production-service-NNNN` naming. — Any tool that loads this generated catalog as a service map will hit a type error on this entry.

## Not reviewed
- This review did not read all of the `aaa-generated/catalog.json` diff: lines 2234–8979 of `../pr.diff` were checked only by a line-shape pattern search, so it did not confirm that each service name matches its port in that range.
